name: RoofGS Dual-Pixel Incremental Evaluation
definition: An optimization that exploits spatial coherence between vertically adjacent pixels by assigning each thread to process two pixels, $(x, y)$ and $(x, y+1)$, allowing reuse of shared-memory attribute loads and incremental exponent calculation.
summary: RoofGS Dual-Pixel Incremental Evaluation optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by processing vertically adjacent pixels together, halving shared-memory traffic and replacing full exponent calculations with lightweight incremental updates.
